population_accounting.status: Inherited underwriting pools, not new observed counts. Other prevention cannot all be labeled injectables.
population_accounting.growth: Preserve net1.5% total growth; do not add gross new diagnoses on top. Newly diagnosed is an inflow, not another starting pool.

XR_segments.motivation: Meaningful residual attack burden or poor perceived control
XR_segments.translation_limit: Claims15.24% is all-destination switching among mixed initiators, not prevalence of poor control. OASISplus11formerberotralstat users selected for switching.

XR_segments.motivation: Acceptable control; possible incremental benefit or non-efficacy preference
XR_segments.translation_limit: No new oral-route advantage over Orladeyo. AE superiority not assumed. Stable users can still switch.

XR_segments.motivation: Better perceived control with acceptable route/schedule
XR_segments.translation_limit: Higher burden supports consideration; PHVS superiority versus effective injectables is not established.
54%oral/46%injection in equal-efficacy simulated choice is not incremental preference, patient allocation, annual switching or PHVS share. No automatic oral acquisition premium.

XR_segments.motivation: Potential efficacy, tolerability or burden improvement
XR_segments.translation_limit: Separate mutually exclusive remainder of4080 only if data support size; cannot add on top of injectables.
Prevention initiation, not competing-prophylaxis switch. Low attack burden may discourage prevention; no imported injection preference multiplier.
Eligibility and clinician/patient selection unresolved. New diagnoses enter existing total growth once.

IR_segments.motivation: Oral administration and reliable rapid relief
IR_segments.translation_limit: 84%oralrescue preference is pre-Ekterly multinational stated preference, not paid capture. Ekterly earlyforms anchor category conversion, not PHVS share.

IR_segments.motivation: Incremental response, durability or tolerability versus existing oral rescue
IR_segments.translation_limit: No oral convenience premium; no public observed Ekterly-to-PHVS transition. Redosing percentages alone do not identify dissatisfied patients or annual switching.

IR_segments.motivation: First rescue selection or provision of missing rescue
IR_segments.translation_limit: Do not equate this solely with diagnoseduntreated: some prophylaxis users may have no current rescue. No claim can mean stock at home, not no rescue.

rules: Use joint states: current prevention origin x primary rescue origin. Row sums match prevention pools; all joint cells sum to diagnosed population. IR/XR are overlapping treatment ledgers, not additive unique patients.
For patients holding multiple rescue products, assign one primary strategy with a declared rule; preserve backup possession as an attribute, never two people. Current shares are unknown.
Within Orladeyo/injectables, classify meaningful control burden first; remaining is the complement. Convenience preference can exist in either class but cannot form a second additive patient pool.
Prior oral failure, tolerability concerns and access are overlapping attributes. FormerOrladeyo patients now on injections remain in injection pool.

Observed54/46preference applies to simulated dailyoral prevention versus specified injection schedules at equal efficacy, not rescue. Long-interval schedules and currentuser preferences require their own comparisons.
XR Rx attempts=sum_g available_g*q_g(t); q=1-(1-annual_p)^(1/12). Apply paidconversion once after attempts and access delay. No multiply by54%,71%,15% survey figures.
IR acquisition uses currentrescue origin; prophylaxis background determines8/14dose assumptions and changes with PHVSXR initiation. Do not use prevention origin as a substitute for rescue origin.
Finite highinterest pools can deplete faster and cause taper; time-varying reach/access can offset that. No empirical decay coefficient established. New netentrants allocated once, not duplicated.

Working80%paidconversion and1monthdelay are inherited assumptions shared acrosssegments until distinct evidence; preprescription access friction included in Rx propensity. Filledclaims benchmark already incorporates historicalaccess.
Existing10%IR,10%Orladeyo,4%otherprevention are legacy aggregate references, not assigned as identical subgroup forecasts. No new marketshare or confidenceinterval inferred.
